YTC — Mayo Sailing Club Cruisers YTC, Spring Series 2026 (HalSail parity)

YTC (RYA Yacht Time Correction) is time-on-time with the Portsmouth yardstick's maths: corrected time = elapsed × 1000 / YTC, so a lower number is a faster boat. This is Mayo Sailing Club's 2026 Spring Series for its Cruisers YTC fleet, as published on HalSail (halsail.com/Result/Public/96252): seven boats, five races, every number equal to the spinnaker YTC on the boat's RORC certificate. Corrected times round half-up to the second; all 25 match HalSail's exactly. Coded finishes score the boats that came to the start + 1 — DNC included, which is not RRS A5.3 (there DNC scores the entries + 1), so the series changes DNC to score as DNF. One discard.

Scoring system: YTC 
Mayo scores DNC as the boats that came to the start + 1, like DNF.
Standings exactly as HalSail publishes them; "(…)" there is a discard here.
